items.summary:
If you ask me weeks/months ago, if I'd recommend this game: Yes, it's a great game!
Now, I'd say: Absolutely not!
Here are the main reasons:
-The game has introduced one of the largest scale powercreep I've ever seen in any gacha game (I've played 30+ gacha games).
-Character dupes are not optional: You need at least 3 copies of every character to unlock their "real" skills, but to unlock their full potential, you need 12 copies. You used to be able to handle most content with 
-Effective pull income is pretty low compared to how much you are supposed to pull: although average monthly pulls might reach 100, if you can clear every resetting endgame content (I personally can't anymore, not even close), but about 70% of these pulls are standard pulls, and standard characters (even after the "pseudo" buffs, even if you max copies) are only good to collect the dust (few exceptions). Also they decided to give "expiring pulls" to the game, instead of limited banner pulls, so you can't even save properly for characters you want. (Note: character reruns feel incredibly slow, I'm waiting for a rerun for 3+ months, that's 7 cycles of endgames without the character who would make 1 of my teams somewhat working, it's a really unfriendly system).
-For endgame, you'll need at least 5 teams, 20 characters, teams must have a good synergy, you need 40 weapons (WoD) that also synergyze w these characters. Weapon copies are converted to strengthen the 1st weapon with the same name, up to 12 copies. You can't share them between teams (fun, right?), all this effort just to get ~5-10 extra pulls/month. 1 of these investigations can last even for 1 hour, imagine how fun to start again after realizing, this boss is too much for you. 
-Side content is heavily time-gated, locked behind dailies, and this currency can't even be stocked up. You gotta keep logging in for months to unlock side stories, you are not absolutely allowed to experience the story in your own pace. You thought you can have fun in a game in 2026????!! Are you crazy?
-All of the gear system is locked behind main story. If you wanna build a character, there is a chance you'll need to get through tens to a hundred hours of story, just to unlock the place where you can farm them (there is a skip button though, but it's not instant either since there are many fights in these chapters). The gearing system RNG and upgrading is really arduous for the sake of being arduous.
-Character progression later on becomes extremely slow (maxing out just one character can result in 2-3months of targeted farming (I have no maxed character yet, with 4+ months, 140 hrs of gametime). 
All the "limit break" materials are locked behind hard endgame mode, and they give very little amount even if you can complete it.
-The UI is horrendous for almost every content. During fights, the only way to read a card's description is an "auto-roll text" feature, but there are some cards that have longer descr than the whole LotR series. Very convenient, good design. Would be hard to fix! During story, the UI only shows 2 lines of text. If you click once, the shown lines go down by one. You can't go backwards. There are some cases when there's 8 lines of text, and it feels terrible to read them this way. All of the stories are unvoiced.
-The game rather enforces you to play a PvP minigame with completely different rules, cards and systems on a weekly basis just to earn a few extra pulls, than playing the game you came here for.
-You are being bombarded every single day with the well known "900% value pack" that mostly sells stamina while the resources you want can't even be farmed with stamina at all, and it won't even help you with your progression.

"You saved Morimens". Once, this game made a miraculous comeback, after almost disbanding twice, having financial issues, they decided to finish the game in a haste. Truly impressive, and I also got captivated. This game was in a pretty good state for a while, but I feel like the "magic" of this game is completely lost, I feel like the team that added the soul to game are gone, I can't see any sign of them anymore. All I see now is the familiar gacha game practices at an extreme rate. Some of these are "necessary" so I was trying to tolerate it, co-exist with it, hoping that it'll become better, but my experiences are getting worse with each day. 

If you're looking for the saddest story related to Morimens, you won't find it within some of the storychapters, it's in the way this game treats its loyal players. :(
"Thank you for saving Morimens."

items.title: [负面] the game is a huge time investment. I mean if you...
items.summary: the game is a huge time investment. I mean if you do actually pay attention to the story which isn't all that good you'll realise its not worth it. I mean the setting is Victorian and that's different I suppose, but its still bland and you realise you don't really care for the characters soon. the music and animation and character design is different but its Moreso a game that looks good then actually is. the gacha pull rates are decent. Jenkins needs correction for being a cute little thief and so does lily for being such a bland pity case. maybe in another life this sensei can correct them properly. 2/10.
